description: Given a token contract address (EVM 0x… or Solana), say what it is: a token’s own contract, an official deployment, a listed wrapper or bridge, or a copy trading under a real token’s ticker that no list names, and whether that copy’s owner can take or freeze tokens. Use before anyone buys or bridges by address, or when a link or airdrop names a contract. Covers the top 1000 tokens.

lang.description: Language of the text answer: en or ru

name: check_contract

at.description: When the snapshot answered from was read

chain.description: DexScreener chain id when seen on a DEX; null when only a list names it

id.description: The token this address is, or trades as a copy of

listedAs.description: For wrappers, the wrapper’s own CoinGecko id

hit.description: Null when no list names it and no DEX search for a top token turned it up

home.description: The token’s own contract, to point to when the address is not it

url.description: The token’s page, when the address belongs to one

title: Is this contract the real token?
